pull.title: bip375: import DLEQ and secp256k1lab from BIP374 instead of vendoring
pull.body:
`bip-0375/deps/dleq.py` copied the `dleq_*` functions from `bip-0374/reference.py`, depends on it, and could go out of sync (#2262, #2304). Replace it with a loader so the validator always uses the current `bip-0374/reference.py`.

After that change, the local `bip-0375/deps/secp256k1lab` copy is unused. Drop the vendored tree, remove its README entry, and point `test_runner.py` at `bip-0374/secp256k1lab/src` with an existence check.

This leaves a single source of truth for both the DLEQ functions and the shared secp256k1lab dependency.

Added a note in BIP 374 to indicate 375 is downstream and should be tested before any functional changes to 374's `reference.py` or its secp256k1lab subtree.

To run the tests:

```bash
python bip-0375/test_runner.py

events.message:
bip375: import DLEQ from BIP-374 instead of vendoring

bip-0375/deps/dleq.py was a copy of bip-0374/reference.py
and could go out of sync. Replace the copy with a loader so
the validator always uses the current BIP-374 reference.py.

events.body:
I suggest also dropping `bip-0375/deps/secp256k1lab` in this PR, with its README entry, and pointing its path in `test_runner.py` to `bip-0374/secp256k1lab/src`. I tried this locally and the 43 tests pass. The path change is needed: with the copy dropped and the path unchanged, importing `validator.inputs` before `deps.dleq` fails with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'secp256k1lab'`.

At 503119d that copy is no longer used. `deps/dleq.py` loads `bip-0374/reference.py`, which puts `bip-0374/secp256k1lab/src` at the front of `sys.path`. This happens before the validator's first `secp256k1lab` import. So the validator already runs on BIP-374's copy, as `python3 -v bip-0375/test_runner.py` shows. The tests pass either way because the two copies are identical today. If they drift apart, no test will notice, and the README will still list the unused copy as a dependency.

events.message: bip374: note bip375 downstream dependency on reference.py and secp256k1lab

events.body: Per an offline suggestion from @macgyver13, added a note in 374 to indicate 375 is downstream and should be tested before any functional changes to 374's `reference.py` or its secp256k1lab subtree.

ACK 8f9b1f3df7911a6e50c669734621f83af32300be

The removed `bip-0375/deps/secp256k1lab` is the same git tree as `bip-0374/secp256k1lab` on master (`f9ecfa0a`), and `deps/dleq.py` already got BIP 374's copy through `bip-0374/reference.py`, so pointing `test_runner.py` there leaves the validator on the same code. Nothing else in the repository refers to the removed copy, and the note added to BIP 374 describes the dependency as it now is. On this head all 43 BIP 375 tests pass.
